prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 中文 · API 参数说明 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 6 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 17px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "参数" · longest unbreakable word 139px · one-line width 139px
  col 2: header "类型" · longest unbreakable word 56px · one-line width 56px
  col 3: header "必填" · longest unbreakable word 18px · one-line width 35px
  col 4: header "默认值" · longest unbreakable word 93px · one-line width 93px
  col 5: header "说明" · longest unbreakable word 110px · one-line width 552px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 624px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 623px.
Fixed: content, font, 17px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"说明 API 参数的名称、类型、必填性、默认值和用途，帮助读者构造请求。","reading":"读者先按参数名定位，再横向查看约束和说明；也可能纵向比较必填性或默认值。每行应保持清晰的对应关系。","groups":["参数和类型共同标识字段及其数据格式。","必填和默认值共同说明调用时的取值要求。","说明列解释用途和取值范围，适合获得剩余空间。"],"keep_intact":["参数名，包括 include_deleted 和 callback_url","类型名及必填值","默认值，包括 created_at、false 和 20","说明中的代码标识符"],"may_wrap":["说明中的中文短语可自然换行；较长说明形成的行高也可容纳同一行其他单元格。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [160, 77, 56, 114, 216] · table 624×475px · row heights [39, 92, 92, 93, 66, 92] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [160, 77, 53, 114, 219] · table 624×501px · row heights [66, 92, 92, 93, 66, 92] · column headers wrapped 1/5 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"参数名、类型、必填值和默认值均保持完整，表头处于同一行；说明列自然换行，每行的字段与解释对应清楚。列宽随内容作用分配，便于先定位参数，再横向查阅约束和用途。","problems":"说明列较窄，长说明需要三行，表格因此较高；部分中文短语在行尾被拆开。","cause":"说明列为216px，扣除内边距和边框后仅有195px文本空间。其他列已接近保持最长标识符和表头完整所需的最小宽度，难以在624px视口内进一步扩展说明列。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"参数名、类型、默认值及说明中的代码标识符保持完整；说明列比r1A宽3px。","problems":"“必填”表头被拆成两行，表头明显高于其他列，破坏横向节奏；说明列增加的空间没有减少正文行高，整表反而更高。","cause":"必填列从56px缩至53px，扣除21px后只剩32px，小于“必填”所需的35px；转给说明列的3px不足以产生有价值的换行改善。"}],"done":true,"designs":[]}
